record.field: High-performance ARM Cortex-M7 MCU, 2MB Flash, 1MB RAM. Optimized for high-speed connectivity and sophisticated graphics control systems. Technical Features: 480 MHz core frequency, dual-precision FPU, L1 cache, hardware crypto acceleration, advanced TFT-LCD controller, and rich connectivity (USB OTG, Ethernet, CAN-FD). Applications: Industrial automation, high-end medical equipment, graphics-rich HMI interfaces, and smart gateway routing setups.

32-bit ARM Cortex-M3 MCU, 64KB Flash, 20KB RAM.Popular, robust design controller widely used in hobbyist electronics and smart sensor modules. Technical Features: 72 MHz core clock, nested vectored interrupt controller (NVIC), DMA support, multi-channel 12-bit ADC, alongside standard I2C, SPI, and USART peripherals. Applications: General-purpose industrial automation, consumer electronics prototyping, robotic controls, and sensory acquisition modules.

ARM Cortex-M4 MCU with math accelerator and high-resolution timers (HRTIM). Highly efficient for digital power supply control circuits. Technical Features: 170 MHz core with FPU, Cordic and FMAC math co-processors, 184-ps high-resolution timer structure, multiple fast comparators, and operational amplifiers. Applications: Digital switch-mode power supplies (SMPS), solar inverters, complex motor control loops, and high-frequency light-dimming infrastructures.

Dual-core ARM Cortex-M33 MCU, 640KB Flash. Built-in trust architecture hardware security keys for IoT deployments. Technical Features: Dual Arm Cortex-M33 architecture operating up to 150 MHz, TrustZone security tech, CASPER crypto engine, PUF (Physical Unclonable Function) keys, and integrated USB audio capabilities. Applications: Secure IoT sensor nodes, industrial edge gateways, smart lock entry nodes, and cryptographic terminal devices.

Crossover MCU 600MHz ARM Cortex-M7. High performance processing capabilities bridging the gap between MPUs and low-power MCUs. Technical Features: 600 MHz Arm Cortex-M7 core, 1MB on-chip SRAM, advanced real-time external memory interfaces (FlexSPI), 2D graphics acceleration engine, and dual high-speed USB ports. Applications: High-end audio parsing, industrial real-time monitoring systems, motor vehicle predictive telemetry engines, and high-frame-rate display units.

32-bit MIPS MCU 252MHz, 2MB Flash. High floating-point processing computational power with embedded hardware crypto engines. Technical Features: MIPS32 microAptiv core with hardware FPU, 512KB SRAM, hardware crypto parsing (AES, DES, SHA, MD5), 12-bit ADC array, and integrated Ethernet MAC module. Applications: Commercial payment gateways, encrypted automotive network frames, advanced industrial sensory instrumentation panels, and automation communication hubs.

8-bit AVR MCU 32KB Flash. Arduino compatible surface mount component ideal for generic prototyping setups. Technical Features: 20 MHz peak operations, 2KB SRAM, 1KB EEPROM, 23 programmable I/O channels, 10-bit ADC converter, and exceptionally low operating current metrics. Applications: Academic electronic courses, rapid logic validation setups, peripheral smart node switches, and simple domestic consumer device controllers.

Ultra-low-power 16-bit MCU with FRAM non-volatile storage capabilities for logging sensor telemetry data safely without consuming excessive energy. Technical Features: 16 MHz 16-bit RISC core, 256KB non-volatile FRAM storage array (fast write execution), integrated low-energy accelerator (LEA) for vector math processing, and direct DMA paths. Applications: Remote solar/battery environmental loggers, structural health structural sensors, sub-meter utility equipment panels, and wearable medical sensors.

32-bit RX MCU 240MHz with Ethernet control channels. Geared for sophisticated automation networking hardware infrastructure. Technical Features: 240 MHz RXv3 proprietary core, double-precision FPU, up to 4MB dual-bank Flash memory, integrated dual-channel Ethernet MAC, and dedicated cryptographic security framework blocks. Applications: Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), heavy manufacturing conveyor logic nodes, high-capacity centralized industrial building switches, and machine vision setups.

Wi-Fi+BT SoC module 16MB Flash 8MB PSRAM. Complete networking capabilities with acceleration mechanisms for artificial intelligence tasks. Technical Features: Dual-core Xtensa 32-bit LX7 processor reaching 240 MHz, integrated 2.4GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 5 (LE) radio antennas, and hardware vector extensions for AI vector parsing operations. Applications: Voice-controlled smart home devices, IoT cameras, edge-based artificial intelligence modules, and wireless mesh networks.

400mA 17V Step-Down Converter 60nA ultra-low quiescent current. Perfect for stretching single-cell battery operation spans. Technical Features: Input range from 1.8V to 6.5V, ultra-low 60nA operating Iq, integrated STOP function to immediately cease switching, and high power conversion efficiency at light loads (at 10uA current levels). Applications: Wearable tech frameworks, multi-year smart water or gas utility meters, handheld diagnostic biomedical units, and asset tracking devices.

100W LLC Resonant Controller. High performance power topology manager that minimizes loss and electromagnetic emissions. Technical Features: Four-switch synchronous buck-boost topology control framework, wide input capability (4.2V up to 55V operating span), adaptive loop drive systems, and programmable cycling limits. Applications: Industrial high-efficiency DC-to-DC converters, high-capacity USB Power Delivery systems, vehicle auxiliary power blocks, and LED lighting grids.

Multi-output PMIC for automotive applications. Engineered explicitly for functional safety setups under rigorous conditions. Technical Features: Multi-rail output system (Buck, Boost, Linear controllers), compliant with ISO 26262 ASIL-D functional safety specifications, multi-window watchdog trackers, and functional interrupt safety signals. Applications: Electronic Power Steering (EPS) computers, advanced braking system modules, automotive powertrain ECUs, and high-reliability industrial functional safety designs.

Continuous Conduction Mode PFC Controller. Ideal for creating highly efficient front-end steps in server power frames. Technical Features: Continuous Conduction Mode (CCM) switching profile, 65 kHz fixed operation frequency, internal overvoltage protection circuits, tracking boost capability, and low startup draw benchmarks. Applications: Data center server power racks, high-output industrial charging arrays, large flat-panel displays, and consumer appliance power entry steps.

1-Cell ModelGauge m5 EZ Fuel Gauge. Tracks battery remaining runtime effortlessly without needing complex custom calibrations. Technical Features: ModelGauge m5 algorithm eliminates the need for battery cycle characterization, reports State-of-Charge (SOC) as a percentage, time-to-empty, and cell health over an I2C communication lane. Applications: Smart wireless handsets, mobile scanning/printing gear, hand-portable instrumentation arrays, and battery-reliant IoT sensor platforms.
3A 4MHz Synchronous Buck Converter. Minimizes inductor layout requirements via an ultra-high internal frequency platform.

BiCMOS Current Mode PWM Controller. Highly integrated component offering efficient low-current starting cycles for grid conversion rails. Technical Features: Pin-compatible enhanced BiCMOS upgrade to UC2842 models, fast propagation latency (50ns), 1A peak gate driver lines, trimmed internal oscillators, and low 100uA startup currents. Applications: AC-DC switch-mode power frames, auxiliary isolated industrial power grids, telecom base station line cards, and vehicle charging systems.

6A H-Bridge Gate Driver with SPI interface. Delivers diagnostic logs and overtemperature safety shutdowns for motor control frameworks. Technical Features: Integrated high-current half-bridge module with logic-level control paths, overtemperature and short-circuit protection flags, adjustable slew rates for lower EMI emissions, and diagnostic current sensing. Applications: Heavy industrial DC motor assemblies, smart automation positioning actuators, agricultural automation valves, and biometric hospital bed positioning drives.

2A Single-Cell Li-Ion Battery Charger. Features smart power routing pathways to handle device operations while charging batteries safely. Technical Features: Configurable 2A charging logic block, dynamic system power path management to prioritize system loads over charging profiles, pre-bias initialization blocks, and precise safety thermal monitoring loops. Applications: Portable POS terminals, hand-carried multi-purpose scanners, personal tracking transceivers, and portable power bank products.

14.5V I2C Buck-Boost Charger 5A rating. Incorporates fast-charging support arrays optimized for modern mobile communications battery profiles. Technical Features: High-efficiency 5A switch-mode battery path controller, I2C setup parameter configuration interface, integrated MaxCharge technology, up to 93% efficiency at 2A delivery loads, and programmable thermal throttling limits. Applications: Next-generation cellular phones, heavy tablet computing platforms, high-speed remote telemetry equipment, and wearable electronics charging cases.

6-axis IMU with accelerometer and gyroscope. Low-vibration noise sensitivity architecture makes it perfect for drone stabilization controllers. Technical Features: 16-bit digital resolution, low temperature coefficient, highly robust shock tolerance frame, and fast I2C/SPI tracking output pipelines. Applications: Commercial UAV/drone stabilization blocks, robotics orientation sensors, agricultural machinery self-leveling arms, and precision flight systems.

iNEMO IMU 32g accelerometer+gyroscope module. Embedded state machines process raw movement logs locally to offload task weight from main MCUs. Technical Features: Always-on high performance profile, up to 32g acceleration scale range, embedded finite state machine (FSM) alongside localized machine learning cores, and up to 9KB internal FIFO memory blocks. Applications: Wearable workout tracking rings, industrial predictive maintenance vibration logs, complex robotic locomotion platforms, and asset transport tracking arrays.

I2C Humidity and Temperature Sensor. Factory calibrated setup delivering reliable environmental tracking for industrial ventilation hubs. Technical Features: +/- 4.0 %RH accuracy metrics, built-in 14-bit ADC output module, dedicated I2C connectivity address framework, and robust multi-layer sensor housing to prevent particulate fouling. Applications: Commercial HVAC control systems, complex cleanroom environmental management, weather telemetry recording stations, and respiratory healthcare appliances.

High Resolution Barometric Pressure Sensor. Essential for precision altimeter tracking metrics inside aerospace and handheld device designs. Technical Features: Extremely high 24-bit delta-sigma ADC generation framework, uncompensated absolute reading metrics, fast conversion timing cycles under 1ms, and dual configuration support for SPI/I2C buses. Applications: Precision avionics altimeters, professional weather monitoring systems, handheld sport fitness watches, and structural ventilation monitoring panels.

Fully Integrated Proximity and Ambient Light Sensor. Uses infrared arrays to trigger display toggles when users place communication blocks near their ears. Technical Features: Combines an IR emitter, ambient light detector, and a high-resolution proximity signal engine via a compact package, featuring I2C multi-address communication options. Applications: Mobile communication screens, smart home control hub proximity wakeups, corporate hands-free access control points, and manufacturing presence safety switches.

32x24 IR Array Thermal Camera Module. Tracks warmth variances across spaces without violating customer privacy expectations. Technical Features: 32x24 pixel far-infrared thermal matrix array, fully factory calibrated temperature reporting matrix, high refresh rates up to 64Hz, and I2C digital output communication streams. Applications: Safe commercial building occupancy detection, electrical equipment panel thermal scanning, automated industrial temperature tracking, and HVAC temperature zoning loops.

Indoor Air Quality VOC Sensor I2C. Monitors volatile compound fluctuations inside environments to automatically switch on purification gear. Technical Features: Metal-oxide sensory base element with long lifetime stability, CMOSens technology, automatic baseline correction algorithms, and digital I2C communication interface. Applications: Smart home air purifiers, corporate indoor climate monitors, kitchen ventilation hoods, and hazardous environment alerting modules.

Bottom Port I2S MEMS Microphone. Delivers high signal-to-noise ratio directly into microcontrollers without standard analog preamp stages. Technical Features: Digital I2S interface delivering 24-bit data directly, bottom-port acoustic entry, high 65 dBA Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), and wide flat frequency response envelope. Applications: Voice-activated smart home assistants, advanced wearable communication modules, distributed microphone arrays, and remote acoustic logging systems.

Heart-Rate and SpO2 Sensor Module. Extremely small, integrated monitoring module utilizing red and IR LEDs for biometric tracking systems.
Technical Features: - High-density integration containing red/IR LEDs, optical photodetectors, ambient light cancellation electronics, and low-voltage digital I2C read structures. Applications: - Medical diagnostic sensor wearables, personal fitness bands, real-time clinical monitoring nodes, and compact biometric verification devices.

6-axis E-Compass sensor module framework. Efficiently aggregates linear movement logs and magnetic field vectors across orientation profiles. Technical Features: - Monolithic integration of a 14-bit accelerometer and 16-bit magnetometer, low power draw specs, flexible internal embedded signal mapping routines, and I2C/SPI interfaces. Applications: - Advanced electronic compass heading vectors, orientation detection matrices, consumer map navigation hardware, and tracking logistics packages.
